say:0:1821423001:1.text: There are clear <style="highlight">signs of a struggle</style> here. A torn piece of clothing is caught on the jagged end of the broken railing.
say:0:1821423001:1.source_cn: 这里有明显的<style=highlight>打斗痕迹...

say:1:1821423002:1.text: A cold gust rolls over the deck, making you shiver. Whoever lost that clothing would have had little protection from the cold.
say:1:1821423002:1.source_cn: 海风阵阵，你打了个寒颤，衣服的主人是否能赤裸地抵抗海上...
